events.text: You close your eyes in your own bed and open them in no place at all. There is no up and no down, only a dark that is not afraid of you, and in your two hands a seed that hums. You know, the way one knows in dreams, that you are the one who will make {b8dm_world}.

choices.text: Cup the seed close to your chest

effects.log: It hums against your ribs, and you hum back without meaning to. In all the dark, it is the only company you have ever had.

choices.text: Hold it out at arm's length and study it

effects.log: You hold it up to the nothing. It is small and strange and entirely your problem. You will have to be careful with it.

events.text: Your hands, in the dream, are not your hands. They are older and stranger, and they have been alone for longer than {b8dm_world} has had a name for time. A seed turns in them like a coal. Somewhere far off, something that is not yet a river waits to be asked.

choices.text: Speak to the seed, softly

effects.log: You tell it there is nothing to be afraid of. You do not know yet whether it can hear. You tell it anyway.

choices.text: Say nothing, and decide on a plan

effects.log: You decide on a plan, and then on a better one. The seed waits through all of them, patient as a stone.

events.text: You press the seed into the dark and the dark answers. Something rises: first a ridge, then a plain, then, one slow breath later, {b8dm_land}. It is rough and wet and unfinished, and it is yours. Your hands shake, and it is not from cold.

choices.text: Smooth the rough places with your thumb

effects.log: You walk the whole shape of it, thumbing out the ragged edges. It is slow. It is the happiest day you remember.

choices.text: Leave the rough edges, and save your strength

effects.log: You leave them. A world needs some hardness, you tell yourself, and your hands are tired. It is almost true.

events.text: The first ground is cold under your feet when you step onto it, and it holds. Behind you, the dark you came from waits patiently. Ahead, {b8dm_land} is stretched in the half-light like a sleeping animal. You are the only creature in it.

choices.text: Lie down on the new ground and listen

effects.log: Beneath you, the whole young world is quietly settling. It is the sound of something deciding to be.

choices.text: Walk the length of it at once

effects.log: You walk it end to end before the light changes. You know it now, every fold. You could build anything on it.

events.text: The dream gives you the gift to hand over: {b8dm_gift}. You carry it to the middle of the new land and set it down, and the whole of {b8dm_world} takes a breath. Colour comes. Warmth comes. Something that will be an ordinary morning, a long way down the years, begins very slowly.

choices.text: Stay beside it until it is certain

effects.log: You sit up through the whole first night to see the gift take hold. Afterwards you cannot say who looked after whom.

choices.text: Give it, and turn to the next task

effects.log: The gift is given and you move on. There is so much still to do. You do not look back at it for a long while.

events.text: You open your hands and {b8dm_gift} falls out, bright and ordinary as the first rain. For an instant you see all that it will become: every cook's fire, every fisher's net, every child's wonder. You are the only one who sees it. You are the only one who ever will.

choices.text: Show it to the empty air, and say it is good

effects.log: You say it is good, aloud, to no one. The air seems to take the words in and keep them.

choices.text: Close your hands and say nothing

effects.log: You close your hands and say nothing. Some things are too much to say to nobody.

events.text: Now comes the hard part, the part that cannot be undone: the law. You turn it over in your mind for a hundred years or a breath. At last you say it, and the world hears: {b8dm_law}. The words go into the stones and the rivers like nails into a good beam, and hold.

choices.text: Set it down gently, with room to bend

effects.log: You leave a little give in the words, a narrow gap through which mercy might one day pass. You do not tell the law.

choices.text: Set it down hard, so it can never be argued

effects.log: You set it down as an iron fact. There will be no loopholes. Whatever happens, the world will know where it stands.

events.text: Nobody tells a maker what the law should be. You stand at the edge of {b8dm_world} with a thousand wise rules in your head and hold only one. You speak it quietly, at first, to see how it sounds: {b8dm_law}. A wind, the first wind, goes through the grass in answer.

choices.text: Add a second, softer rule beneath it

effects.log: You add, in a smaller voice, that kindness should be easy to find. The first wind comes back and rests against your shoulder.

choices.text: Let the one rule stand alone

effects.log: You let it stand alone, cold and clear. The wind goes round it, and goes on.

events.text: Small figures stir at the edge of the water, the first of the folk of {b8dm_world}. They are clumsy and afraid and beautiful. One lifts its face to the sky, to where you stand unseen, and says a word that you made. They have a name for you already, though you gave them none. It is not the right one. It is close enough to break your heart.

choices.text: Answer them, though they cannot hear

effects.log: You say, "I am here," and they do not hear. A child, farther down the bank, looks up and smiles at nothing.

choices.text: Stay hidden, and let them find their own way

effects.log: You stay unseen. They must learn the world without a hand on their back. It is wise, and it is lonely, and you do not know which of the two you mean.

events.text: The first fires of the first people are lit under your gaze. They build a hut. They quarrel about the door. They name the river, wrongly, and forget it, and name it again. You watch from the edge of the dream with a pride so large it feels like a fever, and with a fear that is its twin.

choices.text: Whisper a good harvest into their first field

effects.log: The barley comes up thick that year. They give thanks to a small god of their own invention, and you are glad to be thanked as anyone at all.

choices.text: Hold your hand, and let the barley take its chances

effects.log: A thin year, then a better one. They learn to store grain. You learn that being unseen is its own kind of discipline.

events.text: Then comes the age you would like to forget: years of drought, of quarrels turned to levies, of kings who forgot the law's small softness. Over {b8dm_world} a long quiet falls, in which no prayer is answered, because you have grown tired. You see it all from the edge, and your hand lies open on your knee.

choices.text: Rise, and mend one small thing in secret

effects.log: You mend a well, a roof, one unwatched kindness. It will not turn the age. It matters to the three people who drink from the well.

choices.text: Let the age run its course; it is theirs

effects.log: You let it run. It is theirs to survive, and they do, mostly. You will think of this, in a hundred forms, for the rest of the dream.

events.text: Dust over the whole of the land. The folk of {b8dm_world} have stopped praying, and you cannot blame them. A winter lasts three years. You are very far away, and very tired, and you are not sure if the law you set is still doing what you meant. A child, somewhere, coughs.

choices.text: Send a little warmth to the cough, at your own cost

effects.log: You send it. It costs you something you do not name. The child sleeps. A mother, in the dark, thanks the empty roof.

choices.text: Stay your hand: a maker who meddles is no maker

effects.log: You hold back. The child lives or does not, and you will never know which. You hold the not knowing like a stone.

events.text: The dream thins. You are standing at the edge of {b8dm_world}, looking across it with one old hand raised, and you see a speck on a small lit road, going about its life: yourself. Smaller than you imagined. Very real. And somewhere beyond the sky, a voice is calling for you by your true name.

choices.text: Answer the voice and wake

effects.log: You answer, and the world around you goes thin as paper held to a lamp. The speck on the road turns and looks up.

choices.text: Do not answer yet; ask what staying would mean

effects.log: You hold back the answer. The voice waits, with a patience you now recognise as your own.

events.text: It is quiet in {b8dm_world}, and you could rest there. You have made a thing that holds. A small figure walks a lit road below, and you know, as one knows in dreams, that the figure is you, and that you are asleep. Someone is saying your real name from far away, very gently, as you would say it to a child.

choices.text: Take the hand that is reaching, and wake

effects.log: You take it. Everything goes bright and ordinary at once, like the first morning of the world.

choices.text: Ask the voice to wait a moment

effects.log: You ask it to wait. It does. That is the strangest thing, that anyone would.

events.text: If you stay, the voice will stop calling. You will finish the Maker's life in the dream, every day of it, and then the last day. In the room of the world you came from, your body will lie smiling under a burnt-out lamp until it cools. Everything you are will end there, and nobody will know why. Are you sure?

choices.text: Stay for good

effects.log: You stay. The seed hums in your hands, and the dark is not afraid of you.

choices.text: Wake after all

effects.log: Not yet, you think. Not like this. You turn and answer the voice.

events.text: The voice calls once more, very low. You feel what it costs to keep hearing it: a thread that goes on tightening, all the way down to a small room and a lamp. If you let it go, you will be the Maker for ever, and no one at all in your own life. Which of the two is the dream?

choices.text: Let the thread go and stay

effects.log: You let it go. It slides off your finger like a ribbon, and does not make a sound.

choices.text: Hold the thread and wake

effects.log: You close your fist on it, and the dream folds up, like a cloth being put away.

events.text: You wake on your own mat with the lamp burnt low and a grey dawn in the window. The ordinary world is exactly as you left it: the jug, the beam, the cracked bowl. It is only that you look at everything now as at something made. Your hands remember the weight of a seed.

choices.text: Touch the wall, and the beam, and the bowl

effects.log: Each is cool and plain and real. You stand a long time with your palm on the wall, and the wall lets you.

choices.text: Go outside and look at the river

effects.log: The river is the river. You say good morning to it aloud, quietly, as to someone you owe an apology.

events.text: Somewhere in the village a rooster is crowing, and a neighbour's child is being scolded for muddy feet. It is the loveliest sound you have ever heard. You know now what it cost to make a world in which that could happen. You decide not to waste any more of it than you have to.

choices.text: Eat breakfast slowly, and notice everything

effects.log: You eat slowly and notice everything. It is just bread. It is not just bread.

choices.text: Go and help the neighbour with the mud

effects.log: You carry the child's boots to the pump. The neighbour looks at you strangely, and then accepts it as a small marvel.
